# HaulTrackerPro

> Professional load, expense, and profit tracking built for owner-operators and lease drivers. Track every load, log expenses, monitor fuel, and see real net profit per load and per week.

HaulTrackerPro replaces notebooks and spreadsheets with a mobile-first system designed for truck drivers. Core capabilities include load logging, multi-stop trips, expense and fuel tracking, weekly closeouts, broker reliability scoring, IRS Schedule C tax reports, pre-load profit checks, and PDF/CSV exports.
